latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of issue-card-writer for the WeBuddhist team

- Generates structured GitHub issue cards for documenting API endpoints (new, changed, or bugfixes).
- Accepts OpenAPI/Swagger specs, natural language, inline details, or existing issues to extract endpoint info.
- Outputs formatted markdown cards tailored for backend, frontend, or app integration needs.
- Guides user through repo and project selection before creating/linking issues; never auto-creates.
- Card template ensures consistent, scannable documentation with clear endpoint, request/response, codes, and notes.
